text: Artificial intelligence is transforming how we work. One of its biggest impacts is automation, where machines take over repetitive tasks like data entry or scheduling. This frees up time for employees to focus on more creative and complex projects. Productivity tools powered by AI, such as smart email filters and meeting summarizers, help people work faster and with fewer errors. However, the real potential lies in human-AI collaboration. For example, doctors use AI to analyze scans, but they make the final diagnosis. At the same time, some jobs will change or disappear, especially those involving routine work. Therefore, workers must learn new skills, such as supervising AI systems, to stay valuable in the future workplace.
